evaluate_nested_callables: evaluate a nested structure of callables or constants by passing args and kwargs to each callable
summarize_evaluate_function: summarize the evaluate function that recursively maps callables in nested lists, tuples, or dicts
test_evaluate_with_dict: test the evaluate function with a dict containing mixed callables and constant values
review_evaluate_implementation: review the evaluate function implementation using tree.map_structure to handle nested structures
refactor_evaluate_for_custom_types: refactor the evaluate function to support custom nested structure types beyond lists, tuples, and dicts
